timing_derivation: Solid Start sets fixedDeltaTime .02; actual -decisionPeriod10 sets DecisionRequester field; default Academy stepper calls EnvironmentStep in FixedUpdate; DecisionRequester requests on AcademyStepCount %10==0; reset clears Academy step count. DataLogger averages fixed-update samples and clears after observation; Python averages15 decision vectors. Runtime timer-count cross-check required alongside this static chain.
seed_derivation: Python initialization protocol seed reaches compiled Academy Random.InitState and inference seed. RESET command has no seed; Session3/4 wrapper ignored reset seed. Session5 wrapper explicitly seeds its Python RNG and reports reset_reseeds_unity=false. Different simulator initialization seed requires a fresh player process.
randomness_limit: Startup propagation does not by itself establish that different seeds yield different task dynamics or independent evaluation episodes.
